name: Minamoto no Shunrai
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 74); Porter’s note gives the dates as: early 12th century.

poems.title: Oh! Kwannon, Patron of this hill
poems.author: Minamoto no Shunrai
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 74
poems.text:
Oh! Kwannon, Patron of this hill,
The maid, for whom I pine,
Is obstinate and wayward, like
The gusts around thy shrine.
What of those prayers of mine?

poems.title: 74. うかりける 人を初瀬の 山おろし (Ukarikeru hito o Hatsuse no yamaoroshi)
poems.author: Minamoto no Shunrai
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 千載集
poems.text:
うかりける 人を初瀬の 山おろし
はげしかれとは 祈らぬものを
